Faculty 4 - Energy-, Process- and Bio-Engineering
Faculty 4 encompasses the fields of Energy-, Process- and Bio-Engineering and co-operates with Faculty 7, the second faculty for Mechanical Engineering in the fields Engineering Design, Production Engineering and Automotive Engineering.
Please note:
Opening hours only on appointment!
Dissertations can be submitted according to prior appointment (by phone or mail).

Facts about Faculty 4
Three departments – Energy Engineering - Process Engineering - Bio Engineering
approx. 70 professors – in 22 institutes
approx. 2600 students – 15 study programmes
7 bachelor-, 6 master- und 2 diploma programmes
